annotations.description: Failed receiving: increases in two checks in a row (CUTOVER.md §4).
annotations.summary: Receiver {{index $labels "receiver"}} on {{index $labels "host.name"}} is failing to receive data

spec.name: A
spec.query:
(
  max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m))
)
and
(
  max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 20m))
  or max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 20m))
  or max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 20m))
)
